messages:
Maya R.: quick catch from usability test: when a key is created the toast disappears and users miss copying. Not great for screen reader users.
Liam O'Connor: saw this too. Suggest a post-create drawer that stays until dismissed with the token and a clear 'Copy secret' primary button.
Priya S.: accessibility: ensure the drawer has role=dialog and focus moves to the token input which is selected. aria-live for copy confirmation.
DesignBot: uploaded updated panel mock -> https://redwood.design/tmp/key-drawer-v1.png. It shows Copy, Download .env, and a small 'Who can use this' disclosure.
Maya R.: microcopy tweak: replace 'Only shown once' with 'We won't show this token again after you leave this screen. Copy or download it now.' Softer and clearer.
Liam O'Connor: CTA order should be Copy then Done. Copy is the action we want to bias.
Priya S.: edge case: if user navigates away before copying, show a lightweight banner in keys list saying 'Token created: remember to copy before closing' with a link to reveal it for 24h.
Maya R.: agree but keep lifecycle short for security. 24h reveal window sounds reasonable as an option.
DesignBot: noted. I'll add focus-trap notes and keyboard flow to the spec.
Maya R.: action items: Design to finalise drawer + copy order, Eng to implement focus/select, PM to update spec and retention window.
Priya S.: I'll add aria snippets in #eng-a11y.
